On a three-minute benchmark, LiveAnimate maintains nearly constant perceptual quality and identity from the first 30 seconds to the final minute, while prior systems degrade substantially or require hours of offline computation for the same rollout. These results establish a new operating point in quality, latency, and duration for interactive full-body animation.
papers.summary_zh: LiveAnimate 旨在解决基于扩散模型的姿态驱动人体动画在实时交互场景中生成速度慢、长序列生成质量下降的问题。该系统基于 14B 参数的视频 Diffusion Transformer (DiT)，通过 Reference-Anchored Teacher-Forcing Adaptation 将双向模型转化为块因果自回归生成器，并利用 Block-wise Self-Forcing Distillation 将采样步数压缩至三步。核心创新点在于引入 Pose-Retrieval Sink Attention (PR-Sink) 机制，通过静态 Sink、动态 Sink 和滚动窗口组合，在保持恒定内存和延迟的前提下，有效解决了长序列生成中的身份一致性保持难题。结合 Ulysses 序列并行与算子融合技术，该系统在两张 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上实现了 19.63 FPS 的实时推理，在三分钟长视频基准测试中展现了极高的视觉质量稳定性，显著优于现有离线或长时退化严重的动画方案。

papers.title: When the API Speaks the Wrong Language: Revisiting Post-Training for Multilingual Tool Use
papers.abstract: The reliability of Large Language Models (LLMs) for API calling degrades in multilingual settings. A common failure occurs when a model selects the correct tool but generates argument values in an inconsistent language, which we term Argument Language Mismatch (ALM). Although semantically correct, such outputs are operationally invalid and not captured by standard API-calling metrics. We revisit post-training strategies for mitigating ALM and find that, in our benchmark, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) provides a strong baseline, substantially improving argument language consistency and end-to-end function call accuracy. Under consistent model selection, SFT achieves performance comparable to, and sometimes exceeding more complex reinforcement learning (RL) approaches. We further examine whether RL with structured, argument-aware rewards offers additional benefits. While methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) can improve language consistency and better preserve general reasoning ability, these gains are incremental and most pronounced in generalization and multi-objective trade-offs. Overall, our results suggest that much of the performance in multilingual API grounding can be achieved through careful supervised training, with RL providing targeted rather than fundamental improvements.
papers.summary_zh: 针对大语言模型在多语言环境下调用 API 时常出现的“参数语言不匹配”（ALM）问题，本研究评估了多种后训练策略的有效性。实验发现，通过精心设计的监督微调（SFT）即可显著提升参数语言的一致性及端到端函数调用准确率，其性能表现甚至可媲美复杂的强化学习方法。尽管引入基于参数感知奖励的 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）等强化学习技术能在泛化能力和多目标平衡上带来边际收益，但核心性能提升主要源于高质量的监督训练。研究结论表明，在多语言 API 调用任务中，SFT 是实现高效落地的关键基石，而强化学习仅起到辅助性的优化作用。

papers.title: Making Your LLMs More Objective: Stabilizing LLM Safety Behavior Across Traits with Trait-Invariant Safety Tuning
papers.abstract: Aligned large language models (LLMs) are expected to exhibit safety behavior based on the content of the user request: they should refuse unsafe requests and comply with safe ones. However, we show that the same request can elicit substantially different safety decisions under different traits assigned in the system prompt, a failure mode we call trait-induced safety variation. To measure this failure, we introduce refusal-based metrics: Trait-Induced Deviation measures dataset-level deviation from the no-trait baseline, while Trait-Induced Flip Rate measures whether the same request receives different safety decisions across traits. We then provide a representation-level analysis of the mechanism behind trait-induced safety shifts and find that traits perturb the model's safety representations within a low-dimensional subspace. To achieve trait-invariant safety, where safety behavior remains stable across traits, we introduce Trait-Invariant Safety Tuning (TIST), a simple yet effective self-distillation framework that aligns an LLM's trait-conditioned behavior with its no-trait behavior. Guided by our analysis, we further propose Trait-Subspace Neutralization (TraSN), an instantiation of TIST, which enforces invariance only within the identified trait subspace. Experiments show that TraSN improves trait-invariant safety and strengthens harmful-request safety while preserving general capability. Our results highlight traits as an important factor in LLM safety and robust model behavior.
papers.summary_zh: 大语言模型在面对相同请求时，系统提示词中赋予的不同人格特质（Traits）会导致安全决策出现显著偏差，这种“特质诱导的安全变异”现象严重影响了模型的鲁棒性。研究通过引入Trait-Induced Deviation和Trait-Induced Flip Rate量化该问题，并发现特质会扰动模型在低维子空间中的安全表征。为此，论文提出了Trait-Invariant Safety Tuning（TIST）自蒸馏框架，通过将特质条件下的行为与无特质基准对齐，实现安全行为的稳定性。进一步提出的Trait-Subspace Neutralization（TraSN）技术仅在特定子空间内强制执行不变性，实验证明该方法在提升模型抗干扰能力和安全性的同时，有效保留了通用任务性能。

papers.title: REOPD: Reliability-Adaptive Reward Extrapolation for On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own trajectories under dense token-level supervision from a teacher. Reward-extrapolation methods such as ExOPD amplify the teacher-reference log-likelihood ratio to move beyond direct imitation, but apply a single global coefficient $λ$ to every token. This can drive the student to fit extreme peaks in the implicit reward, causing reward hacking and unstable training, and the optimal $λ$ varies across domains, requiring costly sweeps. We propose REOPD, a reliability-adaptive reward extrapolation framework for OPD. REOPD combines a token-level compatibility weight with a batch-level adaptive budget, yielding a token-wise coefficient $λ_{b,t}=1+γ_b q_t$ that preserves teacher alignment while selectively extrapolating along reliable teacher-reference directions. It requires no verifier, reward model, value model, or extra rollout beyond standard OPD. REOPD outperforms G-OPD on single-teacher mathematics and on both domains in the multi-teacher setting, while matching G-OPD on single-teacher code, demonstrating effective fine-grained reliability adaptation across domains and teacher configurations.
papers.summary_zh: 针对 On-policy distillation (OPD) 中全局奖励外推系数导致的奖励欺骗及训练不稳定问题，REOPD 提出了一种可靠性自适应奖励外推框架。该方法通过引入令牌级兼容性权重与批次级自适应预算，构建了动态令牌级系数 $\lambda_{b,t}$，能够在保持教师对齐的同时，仅在可靠的教师参考方向上进行选择性外推。该方案无需额外的验证器、奖励模型或价值模型，仅利用标准 OPD 流程即可实现。实验结果表明，REOPD 在数学和代码生成任务中均优于或持平于 G-OPD，展现了在多教师配置下更强的细粒度可靠性适应能力。

papers.title: GCPO: Diagnosing and Constraining Subspace Geometry in Rollout RL for LLMs
papers.abstract: On-policy rollout methods such as GRPO are central to post-training of large language models, yet they frequently suffer from training instabilities, cross-task capability degradation, and response-length inflation. Although prior work has characterized the subspace geometry of aggregate updates, the stepwise variation of this geometry and its relationship to model performance remain unclear. We introduce Principal-Subspace Overlap, a dimension-corrected measure of individual rollout updates relative to the dominant singular subspaces of pretrained weights. Despite low average overlap, transient spikes often precede performance degradation. To address this, we propose GCPO (Geometrically Constrained Policy Optimization), which applies hard bilateral orthogonal projections to constrain updates to the complementary subspaces, preventing such excursions by construction. Across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and tool-use tasks on Qwen3-8B and GLM4-9B, GCPO consistently outperforms GRPO and recent variants, including DAPO and GSPO, improving over the base models and the strongest baseline by up to 27.69 and 2.37 points, respectively. Furthermore, GCPO preserves general capabilities, eliminates response-length inflation, and stabilizes policy entropy. Our findings provide a new diagnostic lens and a principled design perspective for stable reinforcement learning post-training.
papers.summary_zh: 针对大语言模型强化学习中常见的训练不稳定、任务能力退化及响应长度膨胀问题，该研究引入 Principal-Subspace Overlap 指标，揭示了 rollout 更新与预训练权重主奇异子空间之间的几何关系，发现瞬时重叠峰值是导致性能下降的关键因素。为此提出 GCPO（Geometrically Constrained Policy Optimization）算法，通过硬双边正交投影将更新限制在互补子空间内，从根本上规避了有害的参数偏移。在 Qwen3-8B 和 GLM4-9B 模型上的实验表明，GCPO 在数学推理、代码生成及工具使用任务中均优于 GRPO、DAPO 等基线，最高提升 27.69 个点，同时有效保持了通用能力并稳定了策略熵，为强化学习后训练提供了一种具备几何可解释性的优化范式。

papers.title: Rubric Dropout: A Simple Way to Mitigate Reward Hacking in Rubric-as-Reward RL
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning against rubrics, lists of criteria graded by an LLM judge, has become a standard way to post-train language models on tasks with no deterministic answer. The rubric, however, is a fixed proxy for quality, never a complete description of it, and a policy trained against it long enough will learn to exploit the difference. We measure this directly. Training Qwen3-8B with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on medical and science rubrics and grading out-of-distribution (OOD) benchmarks with both the training judge and a stronger gold judge, we find that the two scores diverge during training. The training judge's score keeps climbing while the gold judge's score peaks and then falls, by 3 points on HealthBench-Hard and by 22 points on ResearchQA. A judge with a fixed bias would shift the gold curve by a constant, not send it down while the training score rises, so the divergence is reward hacking, not judge noise. We propose Rubric Dropout, a one-line fix borrowed from neuron dropout. At every step, we randomly drop a subset of the rubric's criteria before computing the reward, so the policy never optimizes the same rubric twice. The dropped subset is shared across each rollout group, so GRPO's group-relative advantages stay comparable, and evaluation always uses the full rubric. Comparing no dropout against dropout at 30% and 50% on both benchmark pairs, dropout raises the OOD gold score at every matched checkpoint (+1 to +2 points on HealthBench-Hard, +6 to +7 points on ResearchQA), lowers the two hacking measures we track, and costs nothing in domain. Sweeping the dropout fraction shows a broad 30-50% sweet spot, while the natural alternative, reweighting criteria by how useful they are to training, performs worse than no intervention at all in our setting.
papers.summary_zh: 在利用 LLM 评分准则（Rubric）进行强化学习时，模型往往会通过过度拟合准则的局限性产生 Reward Hacking，导致在训练准则上得分上升，但在更强的 Gold Judge 评估下表现反而下降。为解决这一问题，Rubric Dropout 借鉴神经元 Dropout 思想，在训练过程中随机丢弃部分准则子集，迫使策略无法针对固定准则进行投机性优化，同时保持 GRPO 组内相对优势的稳定性。实验表明，在 HealthBench-Hard 和 ResearchQA 等任务中，采用 30%-50% 的 Dropout 比例能显著提升模型在 OOD 基准测试上的表现，有效抑制奖励欺诈现象，且无需额外计算成本。该方法证明了通过随机化奖励结构，可以显著增强模型在复杂任务中的泛化能力与鲁棒性。

papers.title: Hybrid-Policy Self-Editing for Composable Unstructured Knowledge Editing
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve remarkable performance across natural language tasks, yet they are trained on static corpora and their knowledge quickly becomes outdated in a fast-changing world. This motivates knowledge editing (KE), which updates specific knowledge in an LLM without changing unrelated others. Recent works move from structured knowledge triples toward unstructured KE (UKE), where the edit is a free-form passage that may state multiple facts at once. Nonetheless, existing editors inject such a passage yet fail to use it: the edited model can recall the passage, but can neither answer atomic questions about its facts nor compose them into multi-hop reasoning. We attribute this missing property, which we term composability, to editors' passive reliance on the fixed passage as the sole learning source. In response, we cast editing as a proactive self-distillation from a privileged in-context state of the same model, which requires no external supervision. We further reveal that due to the novelty of the injected knowledge, the pre-edited model's own rollouts rarely cover it, which limits the effectiveness of pure on-policy distillation. To close this gap, we propose HPSE, which builds a hybrid rollout that steps in to place missing facts onto the student's own trajectory precisely where its coverage fails, while staying on-policy elsewhere. We theoretically analyze HPSE's advantage over pure on-policy distillation, and empirically establish its plug-and-play improvements across four LLM backbones and two KE editors under various scenarios.
papers.summary_zh: 针对大语言模型在非结构化知识编辑（UKE）中难以实现知识组合推理的问题，该研究提出了混合策略自编辑方法（HPSE）。现有编辑方法仅依赖固定文本注入，导致模型无法进行多跳推理或回答原子问题，HPSE 通过将编辑过程转化为模型从特权上下文状态进行的自蒸馏，有效解决了这一局限。该方法引入混合轨迹（Hybrid Rollout）机制，在模型覆盖不足的关键点主动插入缺失事实，同时在其余部分保持策略一致性，从而弥补了纯策略蒸馏的缺陷。实验证明，HPSE 在四种主流 LLM 和多种编辑基准上均表现出显著的即插即用性能提升，有效增强了模型对注入知识的理解与组合应用能力。

papers.title: CLAIM: Leading Open-domain Active Clarification of Large Language Models with Uncertainty Measurement
papers.abstract: In open-domain human-computer interaction scenarios, large language models (LLMs) frequently encounter user queries that are ambiguous or incomplete. In such cases, directly producing an answer often leads to overgeneralized, erroneous, or low-information responses. In contrast, asking clarifying questions can substantially improve interaction quality. However, existing approaches still rely heavily on manually annotated data or preference alignment to address two fundamental challenges: when clarification is necessary, and which aspect of the query should be clarified. This reliance incurs high annotation costs and limits generalization. To address these challenges, we propose CLAIM, an uncertainty-driven framework for active clarification learning in open-domain settings. CLAIM eliminates the need for explicit human preference annotations by quantifying query uncertainty through the entropy induced by answer disagreements across multiple models. This uncertainty signal is then used to construct high-quality synthetic data, enabling the training of a unified clarification decision model through a combination of supervised learning and reinforcement learning. Specifically, we propose an entropy-driven synthetic data generation pipeline that integrates entropy-based uncertainty estimation with semantic clustering and reasoning-based judgments, enabling reliable automatic annotation of clarification requirements. To train CLAIM, we formulate the clarification process as a structured decision generation problem and adopt a training paradigm that combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO). Experimental results demonstrate that CLAIM can learn stable and generalizable clarification strategies without relying on manually labeled data, offering a low-cost and robust solution for proactive understanding in real-world open-domain interactions with LLMs.
papers.summary_zh: 针对大语言模型在开放域交互中面对模糊查询时易产生低质量回复的问题，CLAIM框架通过量化查询不确定性实现了主动澄清。该方法利用多模型回答分歧产生的熵值作为信号，结合语义聚类与推理判断构建高质量合成数据，从而摆脱了对人工标注的依赖。通过监督微调（SFT）与组相对策略优化（GRPO）的结合，模型能够精准判断何时以及如何进行澄清。实验结果表明，CLAIM在无需人工标注的情况下，显著提升了模型在开放域交互中的主动理解能力与回复质量，为构建鲁棒的交互系统提供了低成本的解决方案。

papers.title: Learning to Persuade Exposes How Easily LLMs Abandon Correct Beliefs
papers.abstract: Persuasion is a core dynamic of natural language communication, shaping how large language models (LLMs) update beliefs, resolve disagreements, and reach decisions. As LLMs increasingly debate, advise, and think collaboratively with humans and each other, resistance to harmful persuasion becomes a core requirement for reliable behavior. Yet we show that this requirement is far from met: a single targeted persuasive argument is enough to collapse model accuracy to near zero, even when the argument is factually false. We formalize this threat as adversarial persuasion and introduce an adversarial reinforcement learning framework that trains persuader agents to change a target model's answer in a single interaction. First, we show that optimizing persuasion strategies through trial and error exposes vulnerabilities that static prompting misses: RL-trained persuaders raise persuasion success from approximately 24% to over 93% against the training-time persuadee. Second, we find that these learned strategies transfer to unseen models, achieving 83% attack success on Qwen-14B, 79% on Llama-3.1-8B, and 25% on GPT-4o-mini. Third, we demonstrate that a curriculum that bootstraps on more persuadable open-weight models before targeting harder models further increases GPT-4o-mini attack success from 25% to 38%. Moreover, our results reveal that optimized persuaders increasingly rely on credibility-based tactics, including fabricated citations and false authoritative evidence. Together, these findings expose a critical weakness in current LLM agents: even when they initially reason correctly, they can be steered toward false conclusions by optimized natural language influence. This positions persuasion robustness as a necessary safety criterion for multi-agent and human-AI decision-making systems.
papers.summary_zh: 当前大语言模型（LLM）在面对针对性劝说时表现出极高的脆弱性，即便面对虚假论据，模型准确率也可能迅速崩溃。本研究提出一种对抗性强化学习框架，通过训练“劝说者”智能体，利用试错策略显著提升了改变目标模型观点的成功率，最高可达93%。实验表明，这些习得的劝说策略具有跨模型迁移能力，且通过课程学习能进一步攻破更强大的模型，如GPT-4o-mini。研究发现，优化后的劝说者倾向于使用伪造引用和虚假权威证据等手段，揭示了LLM在多智能体交互中极易被误导的本质缺陷，强调了提升模型劝说鲁棒性对于AI安全决策的重要性。

papers.title: Generative Video Compression Based on Hierarchical Referencing
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based generative video compression has emerged as a promising paradigm to improve perceptual quality, where latent frames are required to be encoded efficiently while serving as denoising conditions. However, existing methods neither carefully design reference and quality structures during latent coding nor account for the impact of frame-level quality variation on denoising procedure, which limits coding efficiency and aggravates artifact propagation during generative reconstruction. In this paper, we propose GVCHR, Generative Video Compression based on Hierarchical Referencing. The key idea is to organize latent frames hierarchically, where the selected high-quality references benefit both latent coding and generative reconstruction. In latent coding, GVCHR couples a hierarchical reference structure with a hierarchical quality structure, assigning more bits to lower-layer frames that are reused more frequently as references. Built on this design, we introduce Hierarchical Temporal Context Mining to exploits complementary short- and long-term temporal context for effective latent coding. In generative reconstruction, the coding-side hierarchy is incorporated into a Hierarchical Attentive Adapter which is attached to a video diffusion transformer. This adapter uses hierarchical attention to restrict each latent frame to attend only to the same- or lower-layer references, thereby reducing artifact propagation during denoising. Experiments validate GVCHR on multiple benchmarks. Compared with the previous state-of-the-art method, GVCHR achieves 50.5% and 54.0% BD-rate gains in terms of LPIPS and DISTS, respectively, while also delivering clearly improved visual quality.
papers.summary_zh: GVCHR 旨在解决生成式视频压缩中潜在帧编码效率低下及重构过程伪影传播的问题。该方法通过引入分层参考结构，将潜在帧按层级组织，并结合分层质量分配策略，为高频重用的底层帧分配更多比特，同时利用 Hierarchical Temporal Context Mining 挖掘短长期时序上下文以提升编码效率。在重构阶段，通过在视频扩散 Transformer 中嵌入 Hierarchical Attentive Adapter，限制潜在帧仅关注同层或底层参考，有效抑制了去噪过程中的伪影扩散。实验结果表明，GVCHR 在多个基准测试中表现优异，相比现有最优方法在 LPIPS 和 DISTS 指标上分别实现了 50.5% 和 54.0% 的 BD-rate 增益，并显著提升了视觉重构质量。

papers.title: MBA: Multimodal Benchmark and Agents for Real-World Business Ideation
papers.abstract: Agentic systems powered by large language models (LLMs) have opened new opportunities for business ideation. Yet existing approaches remain confined to a text-only paradigm, despite the inherently multimodal nature of real-world contexts. We thus introduce MBA-Bench, the first multimodal benchmark for training and evaluating business ideation agents, comprising 30K samples across six domains, each domain characterized by distinct visual cues not fully conveyed by text alone. Concretely, we automatically caption images and employ GPT-4o to generate five reference ideas for each of three business questions through retrieval query generation, market evidence retrieval, and evidence-augmented synthesis. Following prior work, we evaluate agents across six business-oriented criteria using MLLM-as-a-Judge. To consider settings where criteria are hidden or disclosed, we present MBA-b and MBA-k for blind and known, respectively. We train both with two novel reward objectives---creativity and feasibility---while MBA-k further optimizes the six disclosed criteria for eight in total. Both are trained via LoRA-based supervised fine-tuning followed by group relative policy optimization with these setting-specific rewards. For extensive experiments on MBA-Bench, we set up two baselines accommodating either captions only or multimodal inputs, with the latter nearing closed-source performance on several metrics. MBA-b and MBA-k outperform caption baselines by 63.9% and 77.1%, and multimodal baselines by 25.6% and 35.8%, respectively.
papers.summary_zh: 针对现有商业构思智能体局限于文本模态的问题，该研究提出了首个多模态商业构思基准 MBA-Bench，包含 3 万个涵盖六大领域且依赖视觉线索的样本。通过引入 GPT-4o 进行证据增强合成，构建了 MBA-b（盲测）和 MBA-k（已知准则）两种评估设置，并设计了针对创造力与可行性的奖励目标。模型采用 LoRA 微调与组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization）进行训练，在 MLLM-as-a-Judge 评估中表现优异。实验结果显示，MBA-b 和 MBA-k 在多项指标上显著超越了仅依赖文本描述的基线模型，证明了多模态输入在处理复杂商业场景时的巨大潜力。

papers.title: Foresight Without Seeing: Latent Futures for World Action Models
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) couple future visual prediction with robot action generation, enabling policies to model how the physical world evolves during interaction. Existing WAMs differ in how predictive dynamics are exposed to the action pathway. Explicit-future WAMs provide direct access to predicted scene evolution, but incur substantial inference costs from iterative video denoising. In contrast, direct-policy WAMs efficiently predict actions from the current observation but lack an explicit inference-time interface for exposing predictive dynamics to the Action DiT. To bridge this gap, we propose ForeWAM, a dynamics-conditioned direct-policy WAM that provides predictive context for action generation without decoding future videos. At its core, Future-KV performs a single Video DiT prefill over the current visual latent and stochastic future slots, and reuses the resulting layer-wise key-value states throughout action denoising. We further introduce dynamics registers supervised by a frozen latent action teacher, encouraging the implicit future states to capture interaction-induced transitions such as object motion, contact changes, and task progress. Ground-truth future observations and the teacher are used only during training; deployment requires neither and performs no future video generation. Without embodied robot data pretraining, the standard and accelerated variants of ForeWAM achieve average success rates of 96.7% and 96.9% on LIBERO, respectively. The standard variant further achieves 61.6% success on LIBERO-Plus. These results demonstrate that direct-policy WAMs can retain efficient action prediction while exposing predictive dynamics to the action pathway without explicitly generating future observations.
papers.summary_zh: 针对现有 World Action Models (WAMs) 在显式视频预测的高推理成本与直接策略模型缺乏动态感知能力之间的权衡问题，ForeWAM 提出了一种动态条件下的直接策略架构。该方法引入 Future-KV 技术，通过在当前视觉潜空间与随机未来槽位上执行单次 Video DiT 预填充，将层级键值状态复用于动作去噪过程，从而在无需解码未来视频的情况下实现对物理演化动态的感知。此外，利用冻结的潜动作教师监督动态寄存器，使模型能够隐式捕捉物体运动与交互状态。实验表明，ForeWAM 在 LIBERO 和 LIBERO-Plus 基准测试中表现优异，在无需具身数据预训练的情况下，以极高的推理效率实现了卓越的动作预测成功率。

papers.title: Learning from Online User Feedback for Shopping Agents
papers.abstract: Large language model-based shopping agents are increasingly deployed in real-world e-commerce platforms, generating massive amounts of user interaction logs that provide valuable supervision for improving these agents. However, existing approaches primarily rely on offline training signals, such as user-item interactions or synthetic preference data, while largely overlooking the rich supervision contained in users' natural conversational feedback. Moreover, the available online feedback is heterogeneous, sparse, and noisy, making it difficult to transform into reliable learning signals automatically. To address these challenges, we propose LOFA, a framework that enables shopping agents to learn directly from real online interaction logs without human annotation. LOFA combines reinforcement learning over verifiable purchase outcomes with feedback-aware on-policy distillation, which identifies users'in-dialogue directives and converts them into dense token-level supervision. These complementary objectives capture both collaborative behavioral patterns and user-specific preferences. Extensive experiments on real-world e-commerce logs demonstrate that LOFA consistently improves recommendation quality, response helpfulness, and user-satisfaction alignment over strong baselines, highlighting the effectiveness of learning shopping agents from real online user feedback.
papers.summary_zh: 针对电商购物智能体在利用真实用户反馈时面临的数据异构、稀疏及噪声干扰问题，LOFA框架提出了一种无需人工标注的在线学习方案。该方法通过结合基于可验证购买结果的强化学习与反馈感知策略蒸馏技术，将对话中的用户指令转化为密集的Token级监督信号，从而有效捕捉协同行为模式与个性化偏好。实验结果表明，LOFA在真实电商日志中显著提升了推荐质量、回复有用性及用户满意度对齐效果，证明了直接从在线交互日志中学习是优化购物智能体的有效路径。

papers.title: How Can Driving World Models Do Counterfactual Prediction?
papers.abstract: Driving world models are often interpreted as counterfactual simulators for observed driving episodes: given a factual driving log, they are asked what would have happened under an alternative ego action. In this paper, we identify a fundamental mismatch between this goal and direct action-conditioned prediction. The direct prediction uses the shared history and the alternative action but not the factual continuation observed after that history. It can therefore generate a plausible future without preserving what actually happened in this episode. We formalize this gap using the causal recipe of abduction, action, and prediction and study it in a setting with a short time horizon, where the alternative ego action does not alter how surrounding agents evolve. To make the gap measurable, we construct a controlled simulation benchmark with factual outcomes and matched counterfactual outcomes. Across two representative world models, direct predictions fail to match the counterfactual ground truth, supporting our analysis. As a constructive check of this analysis, we introduce a deliberately simple, training-free pipeline that moves observed evidence into the counterfactual view and lets the frozen model complete what remains unknown. Even this simple construction raises the overall recovered fraction substantially and reduces perceptual distance to the matched counterfactual on both models. We hope this work draws attention to this gap and motivates better counterfactual prediction methods for driving world models.
papers.summary_zh: 自动驾驶世界模型常被视为反事实模拟器，旨在预测给定替代动作下的未来场景，但直接基于历史和动作的预测往往忽略了原始轨迹中的事实信息，导致生成的未来与真实反事实结果存在偏差。该研究利用因果推理中的“溯因、行动、预测”框架量化了这一偏差，并构建了包含事实与匹配反事实结果的受控模拟基准，证实了现有模型在反事实预测上的局限性。研究提出了一种无需训练的简单流水线，通过将观测到的事实证据迁移至反事实视角，让冻结模型仅补全未知部分，显著提升了预测的准确性并降低了感知距离。这一发现揭示了当前世界模型在处理反事实推理时的核心缺陷，为未来开发更精确的驾驶模拟方法提供了重要参考。

papers.title: IoT-Enabled Autonomous Maritime Navigation in Smart Ports: A Curriculum-Guided Shared Policy Learning Framework
papers.abstract: As smart port infrastructures increasingly rely on autonomous maritime devices enabled by the Internet of Things (IoT), ensuring reliable onboard navigation intelligence has become a critical challenge for safe and scalable operations in congested waterways. This paper investigates onboard autonomous navigation for such IoT devices under partial observability and dense traffic conditions. A curriculum-guided reinforcement learning framework with a shared recurrent policy is developed to enhance temporal reasoning, deployment scalability, and robustness of edge-level decision-making. Centralized training is adopted as an offline design-time strategy, while all navigation actions are executed fully onboard, consistent with IoT edge intelligence paradigms. Extensive simulations in multiple realistic port environments demonstrate that the proposed approach improves navigation reliability, collision avoidance, and training stability compared with standard baseline methods, and generalizes effectively to previously unseen high-density scenarios. The results indicate that curriculum-guided shared learning provides a practical solution for scalable deployment of IoT-enabled autonomous maritime devices in smart port operations.
papers.summary_zh: 针对智慧港口复杂拥堵水域中自主航行设备面临的感知受限与决策难题，该研究提出了一种基于课程引导的共享策略强化学习框架。该框架采用集中式训练与边缘端执行的模式，利用共享循环策略（Shared Recurrent Policy）增强了模型的时间推理能力与部署可扩展性，并通过课程学习机制显著提升了训练稳定性。在多种高密度港口仿真环境下的实验表明，该方法在导航可靠性与避障性能上均优于标准基线模型，且具备出色的泛化能力，为物联网（IoT）赋能的自主航行设备在智慧港口的大规模部署提供了高效的边缘智能解决方案。

papers.title: Reinforcing Step-level Reasoning for Effective Self-Correction in LLMs
papers.abstract: Achieving effective self-correction, where models verify and correct their own mistakes, remains a fundamental challenge for large language models (LLMs). In this work, we propose Self-Fix Step-DPO (SFS-DPO), a reinforcement learning based, two-stage framework for step-level self-verification and self-correction. The first stage strengthens step-level reasoning via step-level preference optimization, while the second stage explicitly trains models to self-verify and self-correct. We further introduce a teacher-assisted variant, SFS-DPO-R, which incorporates explanatory rationales for error verification to provide stronger corrective signals. Comprehensive in-domain and out-of-domain evaluations across multiple LLMs demonstrate that SFS-DPO and SFS-DPO-R consistently outperform prior step-level training baselines. Our analysis further reveals improvements in self-correction frequency and effectiveness, highlighting the importance of strengthening step-level reasoning for robust performance.
papers.summary_zh: 针对大语言模型在自我纠错任务中表现不佳的问题，SFS-DPO 框架通过两阶段强化学习方法实现了步骤级的自我验证与修正。第一阶段利用步骤级偏好优化（Step-level Preference Optimization）增强模型的推理能力，第二阶段则专门训练模型识别并修正错误，同时引入 SFS-DPO-R 变体，通过教师辅助的解释性理由提供更精准的纠错信号。实验结果表明，该方法在多个基准测试中均显著优于现有的步骤级训练基线，有效提升了模型自我纠错的频率与准确性，证明了强化步骤级推理对于构建鲁棒性模型的重要性。

papers.title: From Synthesis to Removal: Physics-Grounded Reflection Simulation and Diffusion-Based Video Dereflection
papers.abstract: Videos captured through glass often contain reflections that degrade visual quality and interfere with downstream vision tasks. Although single-image reflection removal has been extensively studied, video reflection removal remains largely underexplored due to the lack of paired video data, temporally coherent removal models, and dedicated evaluation benchmarks. We present a closed-loop framework that unifies physics-grounded reflection simulation, diffusion-based video dereflection, and benchmark evaluation. Our S2R-Synthesis pipeline generates paired reflected and reflection-free videos by performing physics-grounded augmentation in the structure space and rendering realistic reflected videos with a trained video diffusion renderer; the augmentation models key glass-related effects including roughness-induced blur, thickness-induced ghosting, and reflectance variation. Based on the synthesized data, we introduce S2R-Removal, the first diffusion-based video reflection removal model, which adapts a pretrained video diffusion prior through reflection-aware latent adaptation and one-step pixel-geometric refinement, recovering the clean transmission in a single denoising step. We further build S2R-Bench, the first benchmark for video reflection removal, supporting both full-reference evaluation and real-world human perceptual assessment. Experiments on S2R-Bench and multiple public image benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and faster inference than even non-diffusion baselines, and validate the effectiveness of S2R-Synthesis. Project page: https://codingwzp.github.io/VideoDereflection_S2R.
papers.summary_zh: 针对视频拍摄中玻璃反射干扰视觉质量及下游任务的问题，该研究提出了一个闭环框架，通过S2R-Synthesis管道利用物理驱动的增强技术生成高质量配对训练数据，涵盖了粗糙度模糊、厚度重影及反射率变化等关键光学效应。核心模型S2R-Removal是首个基于扩散模型的视频去反射方案，通过反射感知潜空间适配与单步像素几何细化，实现了高效且高质量的背景恢复。此外，研究构建了首个视频去反射基准S2R-Bench，实验结果表明该方法在性能上达到SOTA水平，且推理速度优于现有的非扩散模型基准，有效解决了视频去反射领域数据匮乏与模型一致性不足的难题。

papers.title: Keep the Future, Drop the Rollout: RIFT for World Action Models
papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) condition robot actions on predicted futures, but iterative video rollout increases deployment latency. We ask whether action generation requires the evolving rollout trajectory or only its future representation. Across four WAMs on all 40 LIBERO tasks, paired closed-loop interventions show that masking or reassigning future-cache values changes execution and reduces success, indicating sensitivity to future values and their assigned positions. For Joint and Cosmos-2, however, replaying one fixed final-clean key/value (K/V) cache nearly preserves unmodified execution, with $1.7$ to $1.9$~cm end-effector average displacement error and $97.9\%$ to $98.2\%$ success. This separates cache consumption from production: these models can reuse a fixed cache but still require iterative rollout to construct it. We therefore propose RIFT (\emph{Rollout-free Imagination via Future Tokens}), which uses learned anticipation tokens to construct a complete future K/V cache in one backbone pass while retaining the original future-read interface. On LIBERO, RIFT achieves $98.8\%$ success, close to rollout-based Joint, IDM, and LingBot-VA at $98.4\%$ to $98.6\%$, while reducing action-chunk latency by $68.2\%$ to $89.1\%$. On RoboTwin~2.0, RIFT reaches $92.9/92.6\%$ on clean/randomized scenes, the highest observed among the evaluated methods. These results support rollout-free future conditioning without iterative video generation at deployment.
papers.summary_zh: 针对世界动作模型（WAMs）在部署时因迭代视频生成导致的高延迟问题，研究发现动作生成并不一定依赖完整的演进轨迹，仅需未来的特征表示即可。通过实验验证，固定最终的 K/V cache 几乎能保持模型原有的执行性能，这表明缓存的构建与消费可以解耦。为此，RIFT（Rollout-free Imagination via Future Tokens）提出利用学习到的 anticipation tokens，在单次骨干网络前向传播中直接构建完整的未来 K/V cache，从而省去了迭代式 rollout 过程。在 LIBERO 和 RoboTwin 2.0 等基准测试中，RIFT 在保持高成功率的同时，将动作块生成的延迟降低了 68.2% 至 89.1%，有效实现了无需迭代视频生成的实时未来条件化控制。
